claims.text: The dataset was constructed to exceed the size and classification specificity of other datasets, with a total of 7,787 questions organized into various categories.
Questions were annotated by two annotators, with the lead annotator having professional domain expertise, to ensure quality and consistency.
The questions were randomly shuffled during the annotation process to counterbalance learning effects, while presented in grade order to reduce context switching.
